description: Estimate the monthly cost of sending email with Wraps + AWS: the flat Wraps plan fee and an itemized AWS bill (SES, EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, DynamoDB, dedicated IP, WAF). Use this instead of calculating by hand — the cost model has several interacting variables, including which SES pricing plan the AWS account is on. Requires no AWS credentials.

sesPlan.description: AWS SES pricing plan for this account and Region. AWS defaults new accounts to 'essentials' ($0.16/1K); 'alacarte' is $0.10/1K. Defaults to alacarte.

tier.description: Wraps plan. The fee is flat per plan and does not change with volume.

tracking.description: Whether the event tracking pipeline is deployed (default true)

name: estimate_cost
